name: Yonkers - Single filer $150k
description: Single filer earning $150,000 in Yonkers NY with 16.75% resident tax surcharge

sources.description: Official 2025 NY State and Yonkers Tax Rate Instructions (Form IT-201-I)
sources.notes: Yonkers surcharge: 16.75% of NY State net income tax ($7,951.75 * 0.1675 = $1,331.92).
